name: Press banca horizontal con barra
technique: Apoya pies, gluteos y espalda en el banco. Baja la barra con control hacia el pecho y empuja manteniendo las munecas alineadas.
pose: BARBELL FLAT BENCH PRESS. Flat bench inside rack with safety bars. Left arms extended above chest; right bar at lower chest, elbows about 45 degrees from torso, forearms vertical. Feet on floor and buttocks on bench.

name: Sentadilla trasera con barra
technique: Mantiene abdomen firme y pies estables. Flexiona cadera y rodillas en un rango controlado; sube sin perder la alineacion entre rodillas y pies.
pose: BARBELL BACK SQUAT. Bar rests on upper back, never neck, inside a squat rack with safety rails. Left standing tall; right bottom squat with hips around knee height, heels down, knees aligned with toes, neutral spine. Side three-quarter view.

name: Press militar de pie con barra
technique: Aprieta abdomen y gluteos. Presiona la barra desde las claviculas hasta encima de los hombros, sin impulsar con las piernas ni arquear la espalda.
pose: STRICT STANDING BARBELL OVERHEAD PRESS. Left bar at front shoulders and clavicles, elbows slightly forward; right arms extended with bar stacked over shoulders and hips. Knees straight but not locked, ribs down, neutral spine. Full body side three-quarter view.

name: Fondos en paralelas
technique: Sosten el cuerpo entre las barras. Baja flexionando los codos hasta un rango comodo y vuelve sin balancear las piernas ni encoger los hombros.
pose: TRICEPS DIP ON PARALLEL BARS, not bench dips. Left top support arms extended, feet suspended behind; right elbows bent about90degrees with shoulders not below elbows, torso nearly upright. Clearly show both hands on separate parallel bars.

name: Curl femoral tumbado en maquina
technique: Alinea las rodillas con el eje de la maquina y situa el rodillo cerca de los tobillos. Flexiona sin levantar la pelvis y regresa con control.
pose: LYING LEG CURL MACHINE. Instructor prone on padded bench, knees aligned with pivot, single padded roller behind lower ankles. Left legs nearly straight; right both knees bent about90degrees raising roller toward buttocks. Hips stay on pad, side view reveals mechanism.

name: Curl femoral sentado en maquina
technique: Apoya espalda y muslos bajo la sujecion. Flexiona las rodillas llevando el rodillo hacia abajo y atras; vuelve despacio sin despegar la pelvis.
pose: SEATED LEG CURL MACHINE. Back supported, thigh restraint above knees, working roller behind ankles. Left knees almost extended forward; right knees flexed pulling roller under seat. Side view, anatomically correct realistic machine linkage.

name: Press horizontal con mancuernas
technique: Apoya pies y espalda. Baja las mancuernas a los lados del pecho con antebrazos verticales y empuja sin chocar las pesas ni despegar los gluteos.
pose: FLAT DUMBBELL BENCH PRESS, not overhead. Left dumbbells over chest with arms extended; right dumbbells beside chest, elbows about45degrees from torso. Flat bench, feet on floor, side three-quarter camera.

name: Press de hombros sentado con mancuernas
aliases: PRESS DE HOMBROS SENTADO CON MANCUERNAS
technique: Apoya la espalda y manten el abdomen firme. Presiona desde los hombros hasta encima de la cabeza sin arquear la zona lumbar; baja con control.
pose: SEATED DUMBBELL SHOULDER PRESS. Bench upright backrest about80degrees. Left dumbbells beside shoulders elbows underneath wrists; right dumbbells overhead with arms extended. Back and buttocks remain supported, full body front three-quarter.

name: Press inclinado 45 grados con barra
technique: Apoya espalda y pies. Baja la barra hacia la parte alta del pecho con antebrazos verticales y empuja manteniendo la posicion del tronco.
pose: 45 DEGREE INCLINE BARBELL BENCH PRESS. Clearly visible bench backrest45degrees, rack with safeties. Left arms extended above upper chest; right bar at upper chest, wrists above elbows. Buttocks on seat, feet on floor. Side three-quarter view.

name: Press inclinado 45 grados con mancuernas
technique: Apoya la espalda en el respaldo inclinado. Baja las mancuernas junto a la parte alta del pecho y empuja sin juntar violentamente las pesas.
pose: 45 DEGREE INCLINE DUMBBELL BENCH PRESS. Left arms extended above upper chest; right dumbbells alongside upper chest with wrists above elbows. Clearly45degree bench, feet grounded, back and buttocks supported, side three-quarter.

name: Gemelos en prensa inclinada
technique: Apoya el antepie en la plataforma con los seguros ajustados. Mueve solo los tobillos, baja los talones con control y elevalos sin rebotes.
pose: CALF RAISE ON45DEGREE LEG PRESS. Side view of seated reclined instructor, knees almost straight fixed, balls of feet secured on lower edge of footplate, heels free. Left ankles dorsiflexed heels lowered; right plantarflexed pressing toes into plate. Modest ankle-only motion, safety stops visible.

name: Dominadas pronas
technique: Agarra la barra con las palmas hacia delante. Baja los hombros y eleva el cuerpo sin impulso; vuelve con control sin dejarte caer.
pose: PRONATED PULL UP shoulder-width overhand grip. Left hanging with arms extended shoulders controlled; right chin above horizontal bar and elbows flexed down. Both feet suspended, no kicking, no pulldown machine. Front three-quarter full body.

name: Dominadas supinas
technique: Agarra con las palmas hacia ti. Eleva el pecho hacia la barra sin balancear las piernas y desciende de forma controlada.
pose: SUPINATED CHIN UP palms facing instructor, shoulder-width underhand grip clearly visible. Left hanging arms extended; right chin above bar elbows bent close to torso. Full body front three-quarter, feet suspended, no swinging.

name: Extension de rodilla en maquina
technique: Ajusta el respaldo y alinea rodillas con el eje. Extiende sin impulso, manten la pelvis apoyada y baja despacio sin soltar la carga.
pose: SEATED LEG EXTENSION MACHINE. Thighs on seat, back supported, padded roller on FRONT of lower shins just above ankles. Left knees bent90degrees; right knees nearly straight lifting roller forward. Same machine coherent side view.

name: Remo inclinado con barra prono
technique: Inclina el tronco desde la cadera y fija la espalda neutra. Lleva la barra hacia el abdomen sin incorporarte ni dar tirones.
pose: BENT OVER BARBELL ROW pronated grip. Torso fixed about30degrees above horizontal, knees soft, hip hinge and neutral spine. Left arms hanging straight bar below shoulders; right bar toward lower ribs elbows behind torso. Side three-quarter view, no body swing.

name: Seal row con barra y banco horizontal
technique: Apoya pecho y abdomen en un banco horizontal elevado. Tira de la barra hacia el banco sin extender la espalda y baja hasta estirar los brazos.
pose: BARBELL SEAL ROW. Prone on HIGH HORIZONTAL flat bench, bench elevated enough to allow full arm extension. Chest and abdomen supported, feet not used for pulling. Left bar hanging under shoulders; right bar pulled toward underside of bench lower chest. Side three-quarter, visible bar path not through bench legs.

name: Remo T con barra landmine
technique: Fija la cadera y el tronco. Tira del agarre hacia el abdomen manteniendo los codos cerca y baja la carga sin redondear la espalda.
pose: LANDMINE T BAR ROW WITH V HANDLE. Bar anchored at far end on floor behind instructor, loaded end between legs held using V handle, feet straddling shaft. Left arms extended in hip hinge; right loaded end pulled toward abdomen, torso unchanged. Full body side three-quarter.

name: Remo unilateral con mancuerna
technique: Apoya una mano y una rodilla en el banco. Mantiene el tronco estable y lleva el codo hacia la cadera sin girar el cuerpo.
pose: ONE ARM DUMBBELL ROW bench supported. Left hand and left knee on flat bench, right foot on floor, right hand holds dumbbell. Left panel right arm hangs; right panel right elbow pulls toward hip. Neutral spine horizontal torso, exact same support points, side three-quarter.

name: Zancada hacia delante
technique: Da un paso amplio al frente y flexiona ambas rodillas con control. Empuja con la pierna adelantada para volver sin perder el equilibrio.
pose: FORWARD LUNGE bodyweight. Left standing feet hip-width hands on hips; right one foot stepped forward, both knees bent approximately90degrees, rear knee near floor, front heel grounded. Upright neutral torso, whole body side three-quarter.

name: Split squat con apoyo en el suelo
technique: Parte de una posicion dividida fija. Desciende flexionando ambas rodillas y sube manteniendo los pies en su sitio, sin elevar el pie trasero en un banco.
pose: STATIC SPLIT SQUAT, not Bulgarian. BOTH feet on floor fixed split stance, rear heel raised. Left top position knees nearly straight; right lowered until rear knee near ground and front knee around90degrees. Hands on hips, upright torso, same foot positions in both panels.

name: Press frances tumbado con barra EZ
technique: Mantiene los brazos orientados hacia arriba. Flexiona los codos llevando la barra cerca de la frente y vuelve sin separar en exceso los codos.
pose: LYING EZ BAR TRICEPS EXTENSION skull crusher. Flat bench, feet on floor. Left upper arms vertical elbows straight EZ bar above shoulders; right upper arms remain vertical elbows bent bar just above forehead, no contact with head. Small light EZ bar, side view.

name: Glute ham raise en banco GHD
technique: Ajusta tobillos y muslos en el banco. Baja el tronco manteniendo cadera y espalda alineadas, y vuelve flexionando las rodillas sin hiperextender la zona lumbar.
pose: GLUTE HAM RAISE ON GHD. Knees supported near curved thigh pad, ankles securely between rollers at footplate. Left torso upright with knees flexed; right body extended horizontally from knees through head in straight line, arms crossed chest. Accurate GHD apparatus, side view. This is knee flexion, not back hyperextension.

name: Gemelos donkey en maquina
technique: Inclina el tronco con apoyo estable y situa la almohadilla sobre la pelvis. Eleva y baja los talones sin rebotes manteniendo las rodillas estables.
pose: DONKEY CALF RAISE MACHINE. Instructor hip hinge torso horizontal forearms on front support, padded machine load rests over pelvis NOT spine. Feet on raised block heels free, knees nearly straight. Left heels lowered; right on tiptoes. Side view, anatomically coherent machine.

name: Crunch abdominal en suelo
technique: Con rodillas flexionadas, acerca las costillas a la pelvis elevando los hombros. Evita tirar del cuello y vuelve con control sin incorporarte del todo.
pose: FLOOR ABDOMINAL CRUNCH, not sit up. Supine knees bent feet flat arms crossed chest. Left head and shoulders resting on mat; right shoulder blades raised slightly by spinal flexion while lower back pelvis remain on mat. Side view whole body.

name: Jalon al pecho con agarre supino
technique: Agarra con las palmas hacia ti y fija los muslos. Lleva la barra hacia el pecho con los codos cerca del tronco, sin balancearte.
pose: SUPINATED CLOSE SHOULDER WIDTH LAT PULLDOWN. Seated facing high pulley, knees under thigh pads, palms facing instructor underhand grip clearly visible. Left arms overhead; right bar toward upper chest elbows beside torso, torso only slightly leaned back. Front three-quarter.

name: Remo inclinado con barra supino
technique: Agarra la barra con palmas hacia delante e inclina el tronco desde la cadera. Tira hacia el abdomen manteniendo la espalda neutra y los codos cerca.
pose: UNDERHAND SUPINATED BENT OVER BARBELL ROW. Palms facing forwards/upwards, hip hinge torso30degrees above horizontal knees soft. Left arms extended bar below shoulders; right bar toward waist elbows close to trunk. NOT inverted bodyweight row. Side three-quarter.

name: Aperturas con mancuernas en banco plano
technique: Mantiene una ligera flexion de codos. Abre los brazos hasta un rango comodo sin forzar los hombros y junta las mancuernas sobre el pecho.
pose: FLAT DUMBBELL CHEST FLY. Supine on flat bench feet grounded. Left dumbbells together over chest elbows slightly bent; right arms open to sides with same slight elbow bend, upper arms level with torso not below bench. Light dumbbells, front elevated three-quarter view.

name: Cruces de polea para pectoral
technique: Adopta una base estable y fija una ligera flexion de codos. Acerca los brazos por delante del pecho sin encoger los hombros y abre con control.
pose: STANDING CABLE CHEST FLY. Two separate pulleys at shoulder height behind each side, cables straight to handles. Left arms opened wide slight elbow bend; right hands meet in front of chest in hug motion. Staggered stance, torso stable, front three-quarter full body.

name: Plancha abdominal sobre antebrazos
technique: Apoya codos bajo los hombros y puntas de los pies. Mantiene cabeza, tronco y pelvis alineados, sin hundir la zona lumbar y respirando.
pose: FOREARM PLANK isometric. BOTH panels show correct same sustained posture, two slightly different side three-quarter views, no invented motion. Elbows directly under shoulders forearms on mat toes supporting feet, straight line ears shoulders hips ankles. No sag or pike, fully clothed instructor.

name: Elevaciones laterales con mancuernas
technique: Con el tronco estable, eleva los brazos lateralmente hasta aproximadamente la altura de hombros. Mantiene codos suaves y baja sin impulso.
pose: STANDING DUMBBELL LATERAL RAISE. Left arms down by sides holding light dumbbells; right arms raised out laterally to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent, hands in scapular plane slightly forward. Neutral wrists and shoulders, no shrug. Full body front three-quarter.

name: Rotacion landmine arrodillado
technique: Con ambas rodillas apoyadas y abdomen firme, desplaza el extremo de la barra de un lado a otro en un arco controlado. Evita forzar la zona lumbar.
pose: TALL KNEELING LANDMINE ROTATION. Both knees on padded mat, hips extended upright, far barbell end anchored on floor ahead, both hands hold near end together. Left loaded end near left shoulder; right across to right shoulder in controlled shallow arc. Torso stable no exaggerated twisting, front view clearly shows both knees and anchor.

name: Curl de biceps en banco inclinado 45 grados
technique: Apoya la espalda y deja los brazos colgar junto al banco. Flexiona los codos sin adelantarlos y baja las mancuernas de forma controlada.
pose: INCLINE DUMBBELL BICEPS CURL on45degree backrest. Seated back supported. Left arms hang straight slightly behind torso palms forward; right elbows flexed dumbbells toward shoulders while upper arms remain fixed beside bench. Full body side three-quarter.

name: Spider curl con mancuernas
technique: Apoya el pecho en el banco inclinado y deja colgar los brazos. Flexiona los codos sin mover los hombros ni levantar el pecho del apoyo.
pose: SPIDER CURL WITH DUMBBELLS. Chest supported prone against45degree incline bench, feet stable on floor behind, arms hanging vertically in front. Left elbows straight dumbbells down; right elbows flexed dumbbells toward shoulders. Upper arms stationary and chest supported. Side three-quarter.

name: Dominadas con agarre neutro estrecho
equipment: Barras de dominadas con asas paralelas
technique: Agarra las asas con palmas enfrentadas. Eleva el cuerpo sin impulso, llevando codos hacia abajo, y vuelve de forma controlada.
pose: NARROW NEUTRAL GRIP PULL UP. Two short overhead parallel handles shoulder width, palms facing each other. Left hanging arms extended; right chin at handle height elbows down close to torso. Feet suspended no swinging, full body front three-quarter.

name: Dominadas pronas con agarre ancho
technique: Usa un agarre prono algo mas ancho que los hombros. Sube sin impulso y baja con control; no lleves la barra detras de la cabeza.
pose: WIDE OVERHAND PULL UP. Grip moderately wider than shoulders palms forward. Left arms extended overhead; right chin above bar upper chest approaches bar IN FRONT of face, elbows down/out. Feet suspended no swinging. Front three-quarter full body.

name: Pulldown con brazos extendidos
technique: Fija una ligera flexion de codos y el tronco. Lleva la barra desde delante de la cabeza hasta los muslos usando los hombros, sin balancearte.
pose: STRAIGHT ARM CABLE PULLDOWN. Standing facing high cable, slight hip hinge knees soft. Left arms forward overhead around head height holding straight bar; right straight arms press bar to thighs, elbows stay nearly extended. Cable visibly connects bar to high pulley, side view.

name: Remo en suspension TRX
technique: Inclina el cuerpo manteniendolo alineado. Acerca el pecho a las manos flexionando los codos y vuelve sin hundir la pelvis.
pose: SUSPENSION STRAP BODYWEIGHT ROW. Two straps anchored high in front, feet on floor heels grounded, body leaning back in straight line. Left arms extended holding handles; right elbows drawn behind ribs chest toward hands. Taut straps correct anchor, side three-quarter.

name: Press pectoral en maquina
technique: Ajusta el asiento para que los agarres queden a la altura del pecho. Empuja sin despegar la espalda y vuelve sin dejar caer la carga.
pose: SEATED CHEST PRESS MACHINE. Upright backrest, handles at mid-chest height. Left elbows bent handles near chest; right arms extended forward. Back buttocks supported feet planted, coherent commercial gym machine, side three-quarter.

name: Crunch abdominal sobre fitball
technique: Apoya la zona media y lumbar sobre la pelota con los pies estables. Acerca costillas a pelvis elevando el tronco ligeramente, sin tirar del cuello.
pose: STABILITY BALL ABDOMINAL CRUNCH. Lumbar and middle back supported on large exercise ball, feet wide firmly on floor knees90degrees. Arms crossed chest. Left upper back gently extended over ball; right small crunch lifting shoulder blades while pelvis stays supported. Side view.

name: Hip thrust con barra y banda en rodillas
aliases: HIP THRUST CON BANDA EN RODILLAS
technique: Apoya la espalda alta en el banco y coloca la banda sobre las rodillas. Extiende la cadera manteniendo rodillas alineadas y costillas controladas, sin arquear la espalda.
pose: BARBELL HIP THRUST WITH LOOP BAND ABOVE KNEES. Upper back supported on stable bench, padded bar across hip crease, clear teal loop resistance band above both knees. Left hips lowered; right hips extended torso horizontal shins vertical, chin slightly tucked. Feet grounded, side three-quarter.

name: Elevacion frontal en polea baja
technique: Con el tronco estable, eleva los brazos hacia delante hasta la altura de hombros. Mantiene codos suaves y baja sin balancearte.
pose: TWO ARM LOW CABLE FRONT RAISE. Standing facing away from low pulley behind, cable travels between legs to small straight bar in hands. Left hands at front thighs; right arms raised forward shoulder height elbows slightly bent. Torso upright stable, full body side three-quarter.

name: Cruces inversos en polea
technique: Con poleas a la altura de hombros, abre los brazos sin arquear el tronco. Mantiene una ligera flexion de codos y vuelve despacio.
pose: STANDING REVERSE CABLE FLY rear deltoids. Facing twin adjustable pulleys at shoulder height. Cables cross: right hand holds left pulley cable and left hand right cable. Left arms reach forward crossed; right arms open out to sides at shoulder height, elbows slightly bent. Rear three-quarter view shows scapula and clear cables.

name: Patada de gluteo unilateral en polea baja
technique: Sujeta el soporte y fija el tronco. Lleva una pierna hacia atras desde la cadera sin arquear la espalda ni girar la pelvis, y vuelve con control.
pose: STANDING SINGLE LEG LOW CABLE GLUTE KICKBACK. Ankle cuff on working right ankle connected to low pulley in front. Hands on machine support slight torso hinge. Left working leg under hips; right working leg extended backwards about25degrees, knee soft and spine unchanged. Grounded left leg stable, full body side view.

name: Zancada hacia atras
technique: Da un paso atras y baja flexionando ambas rodillas con control. Empuja con la pierna delantera para regresar sin inclinar ni girar el tronco.
pose: REVERSE LUNGE bodyweight. Left standing feet hip width hands on hips; right right foot stepped backwards resting on toes, front left foot stays planted, both knees bent90degrees rear knee near floor. Upright trunk full body side three-quarter.

name: Rollout abdominal de rodillas con rueda
technique: Desde las rodillas, avanza la rueda sin hundir la zona lumbar. Limita el recorrido al que puedas controlar y vuelve manteniendo abdomen y gluteos firmes.
pose: KNEELING AB WHEEL ROLLOUT. Both knees on mat hands gripping small ab wheel handles. Left wheel close under shoulders hips flexed; right wheel rolled forward, arms near overhead body extended diagonally knees to shoulders with neutral lumbar spine, no sag. Side view whole body wheel visible.

name: Crunch abdominal arrodillado en polea alta
technique: Arrodillate frente a la polea con la cuerda junto a la cabeza. Acerca costillas a pelvis sin tirar con los brazos ni sentarte sobre los talones.
pose: KNEELING CABLE ABDOMINAL CRUNCH. Kneeling facing high pulley holding rope ends by temples. Left torso fairly upright hips over knees; right spine flexes ribs toward pelvis elbows move toward thighs, hips stay nearly fixed. Cable high and taut, side view.

name: Curl con barra desde apoyos
technique: Con la barra detenida en apoyos bajos, flexiona los codos sin balancear el tronco. Regresa a los apoyos de forma controlada antes de repetir.
pose: DEAD STOP BARBELL BICEPS CURL FROM SAFETY PINS. Standing inside rack, two safety pins set at lower thigh bar height, palms up. Left bar resting on pins arms almost straight; right bar curled near shoulders upper arms fixed alongside torso. Clear pins below bar, no hip or back swing, full body three-quarter.
